radio.polar-plots-show-the: Polar plots show the normalised radiation pattern. Azimuth: a dipole's E-plane is a figure eight (maximum radiation broadside to the element) and the H-plane is omnidirectional; a 3-element Yagi has a forward main lobe with the rear lobe strongly suppressed, while square / triangular loops are roughly omnidirectional horizontally (very little directivity). Elevation: a vertical antenna favours low angles (good for DX) and a horizontal loop favours high angles (good for NVIS short-range work). Choosing Dipole (adjustable height) lets you drag the height slider and watch the main lobe change — low heights point up, higher heights lower the take-off angle.
